newsitem.title: INDIA: ITC drives up Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: ITC drives up Delhi shares.

text.p: Foreign investors and speculators snapped up shares in tobacco and hotel conglomerate ITC, pushing up Delhi stocks in early afternoon trade on Tuesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 9.23 points higher at 946.36 at 12.30 p.m. (0700 GMT).
Traders said the prospects of sound six-month results by companies also fuelled buying.
"Prevailing bullishness is also attributed to the expectations that corporates would post strong half-yearly results," said Rakesh Jain of brokers Shree Point.
ITC surged 26.00 rupees, or 4.8 percent, to 571 on strong buying by foreign investors and speculators, brokers said.
State Bank of India firmed 3.30 rupees to 333.
TELCO edged up one rupee to 398.
